contracts: Binding captures a paid paired grouping descriptor vector using existing inference before pruning; ordinary/domain constructors and temporary crosstab pivot alignment retain consistency. No provider or row scan supplies metadata.

Only the active proven integral/Boolean/NULL profile admits streaming grouping. Actual key cells are checked before directory lookup; no first-row inference, carrier coercion or dynamic policy regroup.

Groups retain first key values/declarations, merge within-group policies/completion, and with a resolver apply the complete global per-key-column policy/completion cohort after checked EOF, including numeric/NULL lineage.

Final key substitution is explicitly gated on progressive final GroupKeys. Metered structural matching/cell copies serve scalar, retained, String and byte argument paths; ordinary buffered representative-row evaluation stays inactive/unchanged.

Per-group syntactic aggregate states reuse current Count/Sum/Avg/Min/Max kernels, including raw/Error nullness and resolver-dependent String candidates. No complete source row group or result cache is retained; candidate/scratch/index/state/result allocations are fully charged.

Key and operand work is per qualified row in written order. EOF precedes all output; final group finish/projection may fail after earlier groups, TOP still evaluates omitted groups, and typed sink failure stops groups/arms.

Crossed preparation/execution profiles preserve active grouping descriptors and final carriers; Dynamic default keys reject before cursors even for small actual values. Final aliases and complete key expressions never require an invented representative row.

Interleaved groups preserve independently modeled late reverse-policy String extrema, actual String conflicts, singleton unused-policy behavior, conservative NULL-key provenance, raw/Error observers and UNKNOWN extrema declarations.

False filters, empty groups, later unsupported arms, EOF/first-callback failures, every observed cancellation checkpoint, cumulative quotas, sink-stop behavior, omitted TOP final errors and reuse retain explicit controls.

Existing generated global Count under 8 KiB, Count operand, Sum/Avg and full extrema conformance pass unchanged apart from obsolete unsupported-grouping controls now using still-unsupported Double keys.
